_comment: Gemini 2.5 Flash (gemini_client.py) is now the primary extraction engine — single whole-document call (no page splitting), validated across all 4 sample vendor statements during diagnostic testing (69-602 rows, 65-245s, no truncation), and column-agnostic mapping that correctly disambiguates vendors with multiple invoice-number-like columns. Supersedes azure_doc_intel (see RULES.md RULE-04 for that transition's own history). Deterministic pdfplumber (with internal OCR fallback for scanned pages) remains the non-AI last resort, unchanged. claude/mistral/azure_gpt5_*/azure_doc_intel config paths are kept registered for direct get_ai_client() access but are not part of the active chain.
